pk_STD.note: STD token on sheet-edge ports, reference run

pk_XYZ.note: garbage token on sheet-edge ports: parses and solves silently as Standard port

pk_VIA.note: VIA token on sheet-edge ports: solves as Standard port (token ignored)

pk_AGI.note: AGI token on sheet-edge ports: solves as Standard port

pk_BARE.note: bare POR1 without a kind token rejects

pk_CUP.note: POR1 CUP g1 without CUPGRP: "Co-calibrated Ports do not have groups"

pk_gauto.note: GNDREF AUTO record tolerated inside a standard port block

pk_all.note: SIMPLE Y + GNDREF BOX AUTO + TERMW FEED records tolerated

v_xyz.note: garbage token on a via-polygon port: solves as Standard port

v_std.note: STD token on a via-polygon port: bit-identical to v_xyz

v_via.note: VIA token on a via-polygon port: bit-identical to v_xyz/v_std

v3_xyz.note: garbage token on an interior-terminating via (3-layer TOLEVEL 1): solves as Standard port

v3_std.note: STD token on interior-terminating via: bit-identical to v3_xyz

v3_via.note: VIA token on interior-terminating via: bit-identical to v3_xyz/v3_std

b_xyz.note: garbage token on a box-wall port: solves (box port)

g2_cup.note: POR1 CUP g1 + CUPGRP g1 block: solves natively WITH de-embedding (single-port group is not license-blocked)

xg2_cup.note: POR1 XYZ + CUPGRP g1 block: accepted and de-embeds — CUPGRP is structural regardless of the kind token

mp_cup.note: two CUP ports sharing one trailing CUPGRP: 'Illegal co-calibrated port / Calibration group information not defined'

note: Lite 18.53 em -v intake/solve probes: the POR1 kind token is required but descriptive; geometry determines port type; CUP is the only structural keyword
